_comment: GraphRAG topic config — see PIPELINE_INPUTS.md for the meaning of every key.
topic: AI copyright, governance and intellectual property

entity_types.ORGANIZATION: Companies, labs, industry groups, publishers (e.g. OpenAI, Getty Images, RIAA)
entity_types.PERSON: Executives, policymakers, judges, artists (e.g. Sam Altman, Thierry Breton)
entity_types.LEGISLATION: Laws, acts, regulations, official guidance (e.g. EU AI Act, DMCA, Copyright Act)
entity_types.LEGAL_CASE: Lawsuits and court rulings (e.g. NYT v. OpenAI, Getty v. Stability AI)
entity_types.CONCEPT: Abstract ideas and doctrines (e.g. fair use, training data, authorship)
entity_types.GOVERNMENT: Nations, regulators, courts, agencies (e.g. EU, US Copyright Office)
entity_types.AI_SYSTEM: Specific AI models or products (e.g. GPT-4, Stable Diffusion, Gemini)

relation_types.FILED_AGAINST: Plaintiff (ORGANIZATION/PERSON) brings a LEGAL_CASE or sues a party
relation_types.DEFENDANT_IN: ORGANIZATION/PERSON is the defendant in a LEGAL_CASE
relation_types.REGULATES: GOVERNMENT/LEGISLATION governs an ORGANIZATION, AI_SYSTEM or CONCEPT
relation_types.ADVOCATES_FOR: ORGANIZATION/PERSON supports a CONCEPT, policy or position
relation_types.OPPOSES: ORGANIZATION/PERSON/GOVERNMENT opposes a LEGISLATION, CONCEPT or position
relation_types.TRAINED_ON: AI_SYSTEM was trained on a CONCEPT/dataset/content type
relation_types.PART_OF: PERSON/ORGANIZATION belongs to or works for an ORGANIZATION/GOVERNMENT
relation_types.REFERENCES: LEGAL_CASE/LEGISLATION/GOVERNMENT cites, interprets or addresses a CONCEPT
relation_types.DEVELOPS: ORGANIZATION builds or operates an AI_SYSTEM

questions: What are the main legal arguments being made around AI copyright and training data?
Which companies are involved in AI copyright or governance disputes, and what are their positions?
How are different governments (e.g. EU, US and UK) approaching AI governance and copyright?
What is the role of fair use in AI copyright disputes?
